Requirement: The power subsystem shall provide a regulated 28 V bus within 0.5 V during eclipse.
The power subsystem shall remove non-essential loads within 2 s when the bus voltage falls below 24 V.
The thermal control subsystem shall keep the battery between 0 °C and 30 °C in operational modes.
The communications subsystem shall transmit health telemetry at 4 kbps.
The radio shall provide a link margin of at least 3 dB at 10 deg elevation.
The flight software shall enter safe mode within 5 s of a watchdog expiry.
The flight software shall reject a command whose CRC does not match.
The structure shall withstand a random vibration of 9.9 grms without structural failure.
External connectors shall be labelled with the interface identifier.
The spacecraft shall demonstrate a transition to safe mode when the operator sends the safe-mode command.
The ground segment shall deliver a command acknowledgement within 2 s of uplink.
The space link shall transfer telemetry at 2 Mbps using the coding approach identified in CCSDS 131.0-B.
The spacecraft shall limit the release of debris during deployment to a probability below 0.1 %, consistent with ISO 24113.
The navigation function shall have a position error no greater than 20 m after 1 h of coast.
The spacecraft shall provide a reliability of at least 90 % over a 2 year on-orbit life.
